verdict.rationale: Canny lets a PM move ideas through a status workflow and choose when to send feedback into Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp or Asana. That implies a manual review point before engineering work starts. Drafting PRDs from requests via MCP hints at defining scope. However, nothing documents an explicit scope-review or approval gate. Missing for 10: a documented approval workflow for task scope, sign-off or gating before work begins, scope-definition fields on ideas, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
